framing: He Was Socrates is not a product to be described, but a five-act scroll to be experienced. The bust, the question, the silence, the workshop briefly glimpsed, and a colophon — narrative-as-evaluation.
target_persona: Kaggle / DeepMind judge in the first scroll: predisposed to skim, hungry for one image they will remember. The scroll is engineered to leave behind a single Korean sentence — '그가 답하지 않는 것이 답이다' — and the symbol ⊘.
primary_surface: Single-page scroll-snap microsite acting as the public face. Five hero-scale sections (≥100vh each) carry the entire impact narrative; the actual macOS app appears only briefly in section IV as a small framed window. The product hides behind the story.
opus_4_7_capability: Visual narrative composition — Opus 4.7's grasp of typographic hierarchy and pacing turns the spec's 8 differentiators into a 5-act emotional sequence (presence → question → refusal → product-glimpse → notes), where each act earns the next via scroll-snap pause rather than competing for attention on one page.
mvp_scope: Five scroll-snapped sections, inline SVG halftone bust (no external assets), one slow-fade @keyframe + one slow-scale @keyframe (per spec, minimal motion), Korean confined to identity surfaces (hero subtitle, the question, defer prompt, system-prompt excerpt). 4-day demo: copy-paste single HTML, runs anywhere.
one_liner_pitch: A film-poster scroll where the silence ⊘ is the headline, the bust is the lede, and the macOS app is the small black room you only briefly see.
spec_alignment_notes: framing → reframed core_value_prop ('abstention as product') as a narrative arc rather than feature list, justified by spec's 'first 5 seconds decide whether to scroll'; target_persona → narrowed primary persona (judges) to their attention behavior, not their identity, since spec emphasizes skim-then-deep-read; primary_surface → spec's 10-section preview deliberately reduced to 5 hero-scale acts because P18's persona explicitly says 'product 본체는 뒤편' — engineering details deferred to the colophon (acts as a visual reference to the longer Verification + Engineering sections without competing for hero space); opus_4_7_capability → focused on typographic narrative pacing as the unique Opus contribution to a visual-storytelling brief; mvp_scope → respected spec's 'minimal motion, only one or two @keyframes' constraint exactly (slowfade + slowscale, both ≥4s); language policy followed verbatim — Korean only in hero subtitle, section II quote, section III defer prompt, and colophon system-prompt excerpt; no marketing superlatives; no photoreal mockup (SVG halftone only); OKLCH color space used as required.
